issues.description: EX-3 warning: ABC type questions have correct words appearing elsewhere in the passage. However, this is structural to ABC-type questions in fullPassage overlay — the student still needs to identify which word fits each specific slot. Not a real issue for this question type.

EX-1 warning: sampling appears in passage with blank. The word 'sampling' appears as 'information is lost when sampling' in (B) paragraph while the blank is in intro ('random __'). This is actually helpful context for students to deduce the answer, which is the intended design of vocabulary tests.

Q6-WEAK-DISTRACTOR: Some distractors not from fullPassage. For vocabulary tests, using semantically related but passage-external distractors (pressure, routine, limit, beforehand, rarely, randomly, surface, frame, lens) is acceptable since they test word knowledge, not passage recall.

verdict: PASS — no HIGH or MEDIUM issues. All 20 questions have clear single answers. No ambiguous stems, no answer leaks, no meta-text exposure.
